reason: Linear-probe macro-F1 0.7322 at 5 per region against 0.5983 for frozen DINOv2 and 0.2471 for no-pretraining pixel features (majority class 0.0799); with all labels 0.8154. use: Nearest-neighbor (kNN) region labeling with 5 to 20 labels per region in a caption-trained DINOv2 embedding
reason: kNN macro-F1 rises from 0.4867 (frozen DINOv2) to 0.59797 at 5 per region and from 0.6067 to 0.681 at 20, gaps larger than the label-draw SD (0.0389 and 0.018) and the seed SD (0.00301, 0.00829). Condition: the gain cannot be credited to caption content. A linear CCA projection also lifts kNN (0.5638), and archive-only TF-IDF captions, whose link to the images is weaker, give the same lift (0.6135). It may come from compressing 768 DINOv2 dimensions to 64, and no caption-free projection control was available. The linear probe on frozen BiomedCLIP (0.7322) is better still.
